patch.reason: Initial plan to inspect existing README, create self-contained index.html implementing all specified Kanban board features, update README with instructions, and verify file contents. Functional browser testing to be added in later stages.

goal_obligations.predicate: Workspace root contains an index.html file with valid HTML content.
index.html implements Kanban board UI with fields for task title, description, priority (low/medium/high), status (todo/doing/done).
Adding a task with empty or whitespace-only title shows an error with role=alert and does not change tasks; valid trimmed title adds task.
Editing an existing task loads content into editor, Save task saves changes, Cancel edit cancels without change.
Moving a task status among todo/doing/done via accessible buttons updates the task status.
Deleting a task removes it from the board.
Search filters tasks by title or description case-insensitively.
Status filter and priority filter intersect with search conjunctively.
Filters have exact accessible labels: Search tasks, Status filter (all/todo/doing/done), Priority filter (all/low/medium/high).
Add button has accessible name 'Add task'; edit mode has 'Save task' and 'Cancel edit' buttons.
Each task card is an article with accessible name equal to trimmed title, displays description, status, priority, and contains buttons Edit, Delete, and Move to x for each non-current status.
Keyboard Enter submits add form and activates status move, not only drag.
localStorage persists tasks: initial load has no data; after changes, refresh retains all data.
No dependency on remote CDN, external network, or packages requiring download.
README provides startup command (python -m http.server) and manual verification steps.
Verification is done through real browser operation, not only by inspecting CSS length or source keywords.
